name: Order Must Be Restored
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Do you know how many ranger lords exist in this world? How many human ranger lords have ever existed?

Nathanos' accomplishments were unprecedented. He was a tactical genius, responsible for Alliance victories spanning a decade of conflict.

And now... the champion of the Forsaken.

No. This cannot be. Order must be restored.

Gather an army, adventurer. Return to the Plagues with your army and destroy the Blightcaller.

I wish you luck, adventurer. Truly, you will need it for this battle.
narrative.objectives:
Assemble an army and travel to the Eastern Plaguelands. Launch a full assault on Nathanos Blightcaller and any Horde filth that may attempt to protect him.

Keep your wits about you, adventurer. The Horde will defend the ranger lord with their very lives.
narrative.offerRewardText:
It is a tragedy. I think... I believe that our kind is cursed, adventurer. We are cursed to lose our greatest warriors; our most noble heroes; our most gifted scholars.

We are indebted to you and I assure you, adventurer, wherever Nathanos Marris is now, he smiles down upon you.
narrative.requestItemsText: <Highlord Bolvar Fordragon is lost in thought.>

chain.subtitle: 6 quests at level 60, 31,100 XP in all.

quests.name: The First and the Last
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Mathias Shaw in Old Town Stormwind.

quests.name: Honor the Dead
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Mathias Shaw again if you wish to accept his task.

quests.name: Flint Shadowmore
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Chillwind Camp in the Western Plaguelands and meet up with your contact, Flint Shadowmore.

quests.name: The Eastern Plagues
quests.objectiveText: Scour the Eastern Plaguelands for clues as to the "Blightcaller" and the missing SI:7 agents.

quests.name: The Blightcaller Cometh
quests.objectiveText: Return to Stormwind and inform Highlord Bolvar Fordragon of the fate of Nathanos Marris.

quests.name: Order Must Be Restored
quests.objectiveText: Assemble an army and travel to the Eastern Plaguelands.
